bio: Alex Jun First-Year Social Committee Elm Yard Hey! I’m Alex Jun from Amsterdam, The Netherlands. I live in Grays Hall (Middle), the best dorm, and plan on studying Economics and/or Philosophy/Government. I love watching and playing sports (especially soccer), watching movies (goat movie-> Parasite), making and listening to music (any genre except country), student leadership/politics, and traveling; I’m currently playing futsal at the QRAC, working out at Hemenway, and occasionally in Cabot or Lamont working on a Justice essay or my math PSet, but more often zoning out to Gunna and afrobeats. I’m also looking to join a journalism-related club next semester, possibly The Crimson or the International Review. Super excited to plan a bunch of fun events for you guys, and looking forward to building a strong community feeling for the Class of 2028 and Harvard as a whole! Reach out whenever for suggestions or to grab a meal!
